newsitem.title: CHINA: Moderate quake shakes China northwest region.
newsitem.headline: Moderate quake shakes China northwest region.

text.p: An earthquake measuring 5.0 on the open-ended Richter scale shook China's northwestern region of Xinjiang on Saturday morning, the official Xinhua news agency said.
It was not yet clear if the tremor had caused any casualties or damage, the agency said.
The earthquake, which struck at 9.50 a.m (0150 GMT) on Saturday morning, had its epicentre at 38.2 degrees north, 76.5 degrees east, the agency said.
The tremor hit a mountainous area in a region that was sparsely populated and casualties were unlikely, an official of the Seismological Bureau said.

A strong earthquake measuring 7.1 on the Richter scale hit a mountainous area of Xinjiang on Tuesday. It was followed by an aftershock that rocked the same area on Friday, but no injuries or serious damage was reported from either tremor.
Chinese experts say the country is experiencing a period of intense seismological activity that will last until the end of the century.
